title: Hoi An old town walk
summary: The covered bridge, one old house, the Fujian hall, and cao lầu in the old streets.

stops.name: Japanese Covered Bridge
stops.note: Start at the west end and allow about 20 minutes for the short wooden bridge.

approach.note: On foot from the lanes just off the old town.

stops.name: Tan Ky House
stops.note: See one old house, at 101 Nguyễn Thái Học, and leave the upstairs as the family's rooms.

approach.note: Walk the pedestrian streets to 101 Nguyễn Thái Học.

stops.name: Fujian Assembly Hall
stops.note: Walk the three courts of the Fujian hall at 46 Trần Phú.

stops.name: Cao lau
stops.note: Eat cao lầu in the old town.

seoDescription: A morning walk in Hoi An: the covered bridge, Tan Ky House, the Fujian hall, and cao lầu.
